set.body:
Scope:
Define a durable or reproducible TaskRecord read model that joins Sojourn-owned task/result/artifact facts with a reference to provider-owned execution evidence. Do not add a second lifecycle journal.

Acceptance criteria:
- TaskRecord includes operation/input identity, requested execution requirements, result reference, complete artifact set or publication state, and Sojourn-owned settlement milestones.
- Provider evidence is referenced through a typed neutral reference or adapter-owned enrichment rather than copied into generic scheduler fields.
- sojourn-slurm projects from ManagedAttempt, WorkerEvent, ResultEnvelope, accounting/cancellation evidence, and Sojourn publication without changing their authority.
- Local and pool backends produce the same neutral projection from their own authoritative state and never fabricate scheduler fields.
- Requested and effective plans are both inspectable where a provider resolution exists.
- Reopening or attaching to a task yields a stable record consistent with TaskHandle status/outcome.
- Tests prove timestamp ownership, epoch fencing, cancellation races, publication failure, Unknown, and local/batch/pool projection parity.
set.title: SOJ.O1: Expose a backend-neutral TaskRecord projection
